question: Should ClawHub start serving signed OpenClaw plugin feed envelopes now, and if so should that happen on the existing schema-1 stored feed route or a new versioned feed contract?
rationale: Signing changes the trust boundary and production key handling for OpenClaw marketplace feeds; the current spec explicitly defers signed envelopes until a key-management and trust-root decision is made.

options.title: Keep Unsigned For Now
options.body: Preserve the current hosted feed and defer signing until the OpenClaw consumer, trust root, and production key rollout are approved.

options.title: Sign Existing Contract
options.body: Add signatures to the existing stored schema-1 feed only after documenting the key and trust-root rollout and proving current clients keep working.

options.title: Sponsor A Versioned Contract
options.body: Define a new versioned signed-feed contract with matching OpenClaw parser support before changing the public feed URL.

recommendation.title: Keep Unsigned For Now
recommendation.body: Preserve the current hosted feed and defer signing until the OpenClaw consumer, trust root, and production key rollout are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the feed schema contract note and are tied to the current spec language that governs the signing/trust-root decision.
